lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ElectronicSignatures\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

Nothing in the app calls 7 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 24 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

1 inline style in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 4 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 20 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
7 public methods of controllers are reached by no route.
